messages.subject: minimum read coverage always 10
parts:
Hi,

I am using methylKit to read in sorted SAMs generated by Bismark, and I'm seeing that the minimum read coverage per CpG is always 10 across all samples, upon using getCoverageStats() and before filterByCoverage().  In the methylKit manual from November 2012, the histogram of CpG coverage does show the log10 of coverage starting at 1, so I'm wondering if there is some inbuilt functionality in methylKit because of which we see this behaviour.

I would really appreciate some clarification on this.

Thank you!
Rajat
